personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, Apple-inspired professional networking hub that feels as fluid and visually engaging as a modern social app.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Use md/lg padding inside cards. Avoid dense clusters; use whitespace to group items visually.

do's: Featured Match cards floating info panel

micro_animations.swipe_cards: Tinder-like physical spring animation using react-native-reanimated and gesture-handler. Rotation mapped to X translation. Heart/X opacity scales with drag distance.
micro_animations.story_ring_pulse: Continuous subtle scale pulse (1.0 to 1.05) on the active story ring.
micro_animations.xp_counter: Number ticker increments rapidly with subtle haptic ticks on every multiple of 10.
micro_animations.graph_node_expand: Spring expansion when a node is tapped, dimming surrounding nodes and drawing a highlighted edge path to the target.

screens.name: Splash

states.loading: Full bleed gradient background with Fecap Ágora logo. Subtle shimmer.

screens.layout: Center aligned logo, bottom aligned copyright or loading spinner.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the super-app capabilities (Connect, Match, Grow).
screens.layout: Full bleed scenes per step using expo-image with top-to-bottom scrim. Pager dot indicator, sticky primary CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Login/Signup
screens.layout: Clean single column form. Avoid floating labels. CTA pinned to bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary discovery feed. Stories and personalized feed.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Follow companies to see updates' + CTA.
states.error: Failed to load feed message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with app logo and notification bell. Horizontal ScrollView for Stories (Instagram style, brand avatars with brandPrimary rings). Vertical ScrollView below for Feed cards. Cards use soft surfaceSecondary, borderless, with clear typography and subtle divider lines. Glassmorphism on sticky top header.

screens.name: Match

states.empty: Illustration + 'You caught up! Come back later for more matches.'

screens.layout: Full screen stack of swipe cards. Each card contains a hero image/logo, overlaid with a bottom-to-top scrim. Job title, salary, location, and match % badge in the bottom 30%. Bottom floating action row with Pass/SuperMatch/Like buttons.

screens.name: Networking Graph
screens.layout: Interactive Reanimated canvas. Nodes represent users/companies. Edges show connections. Top floating glass panel for search/filter. Bottom sheet for node details when a node is tapped (BFS/Dijkstra distance: 'You are 3 connections away').

screens.name: Company Page
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a company's opportunities and culture.
screens.layout: Hero banner with cover image and scrim. Floating logo overlapping banner. Tabbed content area (Feed, Jobs, Events, Mentors). Glass sticky header appears on scroll.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User's rich resume and gamification status.
screens.layout: Header with avatar, name, semester. Gamification widget (XP bar, level badge). Sections for GitHub/LinkedIn links, portfolio, skills chips, and certificates. Clean iOS list styling.

screens.name: AI Assistant Chat
screens.purpose: Conversational UI to discover opportunities contextually.
screens.layout: Standard chat interface. User bubbles surfaceSecondary, AI bubbles brandTertiary. Sticky input field with KeyboardAvoidingView. Glassmorphism header.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.layout: Simple vertical list with avatars and timestamp. Unread items have brandPrimary dot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Do not use generic blues or indigos.

Implement the '1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces' personality: generous paddings, legible Geist typography, and heavily utilize expo-glass-effect/expo-blur for sticky headers, tab bars, and floating components.

For the Match screen, build a stack of Tinder-like swipeable cards. Use react-native-reanimated for fluid physics. Cards MUST have a gradient scrim (top-to-bottom clear to surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility over images.
For the Home screen, replicate an Instagram-style horizontal scroll view for Company Stories at the very top. Active stories get a brandPrimary ring outline.
For the Graph screen, create a zoomable/pannable node map. Keep the visual density manageable on mobile by using expanding nodes.
Ensure both Light and Dark modes are perfectly supported according to the detailed color tokens.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across the application (fill/outline variants correctly mapped to states).
